messages:
elaine: FYIwe're scheduling a base-image cutover next week. Main blockers: RBAC for the new signing key, audit sink retention for KMS events, and a pre-rollout vuln triage. Need quick owners.

priya: I can do the IAM bits. Which key are we using this time?

elaine: Created `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/runtime-keys/cryptoKeys/runtime-signer-v4` for the rollout. Intend to scope to the build pipeline and a small set of emergency signers.

kyle: For minimal blast radius, please limit to these SAs: `ci-pipeline@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` and `image-publisher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. No node-level write perms.

priya: Agreed. Plan: grant `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` on the cryptoKey to `ci-pipeline` and `roles/cloudkms.viewer` to image-publisher (only for public key fetch). Drafting terraform.

marta: Audit retention: compliance asked for 18 months on signing events. Current sink is 365d. ops-bot: what's the storage impact estimate?

ops-bot: estimate: +0.6 TB/yr for extending `kms-audit-sink` to 540d. cost-center: infra-audit.

elaine: 18 months (540d) seems like a reasonable compromise. @legal, can we get a privacy waiver for 18 months?

legal: quick confirm  We need the purpose justification in the PR and a data minimization note, then fine to approve.

priya: I'll add a short justification. Also, heads-up: we should emit a structured annotation in the image manifest so scanners and triage systems can correlate signatures -> image metadata. Suggested field: `com.redwood.signature` with `signed_by`, `key_id`, `build_tag`.

kyle: Example manifest label: "com.redwood.signature":"{\"signed_by\":\"ci-pipeline\",\"key_id\":\"runtime-signer-v4\",\"build_tag\":\"2026.03.22-665\"}"

marta: We'll patch the scanner to ingest that label and attach it to vuln tickets. Triage flow: auto-add `signed_by` and `build_tag` in ticket body.

elaine: For runtime agents: they should only verify signatures. Recommend caching public keys with a TTL of 6h and a small jitter. If cache miss, fallback to signature-unknown state and alert `pager` but allow traffic. No KMS writes from nodes.

priya: Good. Implementation note: `getPublicKey` call not high-volume; still better to cache. I'll include a `pubkey_cache_ttl` bump in runtime agent PR.

marta: Canary plan: 15 hosts in `europe-west1-b` for 5 days. Daily image-scan at 01:00 UTC, watch for sev2+ exploitability and startup jitter. sec-bot: schedule it.

sec-bot: scheduled: image-scan for `runtime-base:v2026-03-22` -> cohort `canary-eu-15`, cron `0 1 * * *` for 5 days.

ops-bot: rollout waves: [15, 75, 300, remaining]. Gate: no sev2+ with exploitability > 50% in a 48h sliding window AND KMS sink retention updated.

elaine: Incident playbook question: if signing key is suspected leaked, immediate actions? My suggested sequence: 1) disable key version, 2) mark all artifacts signed by that key as untrusted in registry API, 3) fire off emergency rollout with golden fallback image, 4) onboarding of emergency-signers for re-sign if needed, 5) customer notif per SLA.

priya: We have `runbooks/crypto-key-compromise.md` but it's outdated. I'll update with the sequence and eskalation contact list.

kyle: I'll take emergency signer policy. Propose multi-approver gating (3-of-5) and hardware-backed keys only.

marta: I'll wire up an alert: `image-scan.sev2_exploitability > 50% for cohort -> page security-oncall`, and dashboard for canary traces.

elaine: PR created: https://git.internal.redwood/repo/infra/changes/4399  contains terraform IAM change, audit-sink retention bump, and runtime agent pubkey cache change. Please review by Thu EOD.

priya: Reviewing now. Will post small nit fixes.

legal: approved retention justification in PR comments.

marta: +1 on IAM scoping after priya's nits.

elaine: Thanks. Sync call Friday 14:00 UTC to finalize cutover windows. If anything blocks, reply here. :white_check_mark:

sec-bot: ticket-created: #SEC-2026-491 (runtime-image-signing-cutover); assignees: [priya, kyle, marta]

kyle: grabbing #SEC-2026-491. I'll post the emergency signer roster and policy draft by Tue.

elaine: closing loop  canary starts Mon 01:00 UTC.
